chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Breakthrough to Spirit-Treasury Sixth Heaven & Central Lands Arrogance
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen breaks through to Spirit-Treasury Sixth Heaven, recovering his strength. In the Great Shang capital, he witnesses the arrogance of Central Lands youths who dismiss the Southern Wastes, setting the stage for conflict.
og_title: A New Dawn: Xiao Chen's Spirit-Treasury Breakthrough and the Arrogance of the Central Lands
og_description: Xiao Chen reaches the Sixth Heaven of Spirit-Treasury and travels to the Great Shang capital. There, he observes the haughty young elites of the Central Lands belittling his homeland.
twitter_title: Spirit-Treasury Sixth Heaven: Xiao Chen's Return
twitter_description: After a breakthrough, Xiao Chen arrives in the Great Shang capital and encounters the arrogant youths who think the Southern Wastes are worthless.
